item.title: Cold Rain With Occasional Snow or Sleet Mixed In North - WBBJ TV
item.description: WBBJ 7 Forecast Update: We have a round of cold rain showers coming on Saturday between noon-10pm. Temperatures will be well above freezing at the surface but some colder air could mix in through the higher levels of the atmosphere and cause some occasional snow or rain to mix in at times, especially in the northern counties. No travel problems....
